title: CDC Faces Growing Questions Over How It Counts Measles Deaths
subtitle: As cases rise across the United States, experts worry that new reporting rules may hide the true impact of the outbreak.

summary.en: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention is currently not including four measles deaths from Pennsylvania in its national data. This decision follows a request from the Department of Health and Human Services to change how such deaths are defined. Experts are concerned that the current numbers are a significant undercount of the real situation. Meanwhile, the outbreak continues to spread, with doctors reporting new and rare forms of the virus. Members of Congress have now asked for an immediate explanation regarding these reporting changes.
summary.zh: 美國疾病管制與預防中心目前未將賓夕法尼亞州的四起麻疹死亡案例計入全國數據。此決定源於衛生與公眾服務部要求更改此類死亡案例的定義方式。專家擔心目前的數據嚴重低估了實際情況。與此同時，疫情持續蔓延，醫師報告了該病毒的新型且罕見形式。國會議員現已要求針對這些通報變更立即做出解釋。

paragraphs.en: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is facing intense pressure to explain why it is not currently counting four measles deaths from Pennsylvania. While the agency recently updated its national dashboard, these deaths remain missing from the official total. This situation has caused concern among public health experts and members of Congress, who have requested an immediate briefing to understand why the reporting process has changed.
paragraphs.zh: 美國疾病管制與預防中心（CDC）正面臨巨大壓力，必須解釋為何目前未將賓夕法尼亞州發生的四起麻疹死亡案例計入統計。儘管該機構近期更新了全國數據儀表板，但這些死亡案例仍未出現在官方總數中。此情況已引起公共衛生專家與國會議員的擔憂，他們已要求立即召開簡報會，以了解通報流程為何發生變動。

paragraphs.en: The controversy began when the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) asked the CDC to change how it reports deaths related to measles. Following this request, the CDC removed the Pennsylvania deaths from its website, replacing the number with an asterisk. This mark points to a note explaining that the agency is working with the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists (CSTE) to create a new, standardized definition for what counts as a "measles death." A death definition is a set of rules used to decide if a specific illness is the official cause of a person's passing.
paragraphs.zh: 這場爭議始於美國衛生與公眾服務部（HHS）要求疾病管制與預防中心更改麻疹相關死亡案例的通報方式。在此要求之後，疾病管制與預防中心將賓夕法尼亞州的死亡案例從網站上移除，並以星號取代數字。該標記指向一則註釋，說明該機構正與州與領地流行病學家委員會（CSTE）合作，為「麻疹死亡」制定一套新的標準化定義。死亡定義是一組用於判定特定疾病是否為導致個人死亡之官方原因的規則。

paragraphs.en: According to MedPage Today, the CSTE workgroup was actually formed earlier this summer to improve future guidance, rather than as a direct response to the current outbreak. CSTE spokesperson Amy Heldman noted that this is part of a normal process to ensure that states and federal agencies agree on how to track diseases. However, the timing of the announcement has raised questions. A source within the CDC, who spoke on the condition of anonymity, suggested that the move might be intended to make it harder to confirm measles deaths. The source noted that some officials may want the definition to be as strict as possible to lower the official death count.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《醫學網頁今日》（MedPage Today）報導，該委員會的工作小組實際上是在今年夏天稍早成立的，旨在改善未來的指導方針，而非直接回應目前的疫情。委員會發言人艾美·赫爾德曼（Amy Heldman）指出，這是確保各州與聯邦機構對疾病追蹤方式達成共識的正常程序之一。然而，公告的時間點引發了質疑。一位不願具名的疾病管制與預防中心內部人士暗示，此舉可能意在增加確認麻疹死亡案例的難度。該消息來源指出，部分官員可能希望將定義設得越嚴格越好，以降低官方的死亡統計數字。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the situation on the ground in Pennsylvania is becoming more serious. Dr. John Goldman, an infectious disease specialist at the University of Pittsburgh Medical Center, says the outbreak is accelerating. He reported that doctors are now seeing "congenital measles," which affects newborns who catch the virus before or during birth. This form of the disease was once very rare because most pregnant people were protected by vaccines. "We’re literally seeing new forms of measles," Dr. Goldman said. "We don’t have a lot of information about what happens with it."
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，賓夕法尼亞州的疫情正變得更加嚴峻。匹茲堡大學醫學中心（University of Pittsburgh Medical Center）的傳染病專家約翰·高德曼（John Goldman）醫師表示，疫情正在加速擴散。他報告稱，醫師們現在觀察到「先天性麻疹」，這會影響在出生前或出生期間感染病毒的新生兒。這種形式的疾病過去非常罕見，因為大多數孕婦都受到疫苗保護。高德曼醫師說：「我們確實看到了麻疹的新型態，對於這種情況會如何發展，我們並沒有太多資訊。」

paragraphs.en: Data from the state of Pennsylvania shows 792 total cases for 2026, but experts believe this is an undercount. Dr. Goldman explained that many people who are sick at home are never tested, meaning they are not included in the official count. Debra Houry, a former CDC chief medical officer, agreed that the current numbers do not match what doctors are seeing in hospitals. She noted that when testing is low, it becomes much harder for health officials to track the spread of the virus or tell sick people to isolate, which means staying away from others to prevent the spread of a disease.
paragraphs.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州的數據顯示，2026 年總計有 792 例確診，但專家認為這被低估了。高德曼醫師解釋，許多在家中患病的人從未接受檢測，這意味著他們未被納入官方統計。曾任疾病管制與預防中心首席醫療官的黛布拉·霍里（Debra Houry）也認同，目前的數據與醫師在醫院觀察到的情況不符。她指出，當檢測率偏低時，衛生官員將更難追蹤病毒傳播，或要求病患進行隔離（即與他人保持距離以防止疾病擴散）。

paragraphs.en: There is also confusion regarding which data systems the CDC is using. The agency stated it is currently relying on the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) to identify deaths. However, experts point out that the NCHS is not designed to track active outbreaks. Historically, the National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System has been used for this purpose, as it collects real-time information directly from states. By moving away from this system, critics argue the CDC is creating unnecessary delays.
paragraphs.zh: 關於疾病管制與預防中心所使用的數據系統也存在混亂。該機構表示目前依賴國家衛生統計中心（NCHS）來識別死亡案例。然而，專家指出國家衛生統計中心並非為了追蹤活躍疫情而設計。過去，國家法定傳染病監測系統一直用於此目的，因為它能直接從各州收集即時資訊。批評者認為，放棄使用該系統將導致不必要的延誤。

paragraphs.en: As the outbreak continues to spread to other states, including Texas, South Carolina, and Utah, the need for clear information is growing. Providers are preparing for more patients, and many fear that the death toll will continue to rise. Dr. Goldman warned that the situation is unlikely to improve until more people gain immunity, either through vaccination or by recovering from the infection. "It’s not rocket science," he said. "If we see more measles, we’ll see more deaths."
paragraphs.zh: 隨著疫情持續蔓延至德克薩斯州、南卡羅來納州與猶他州等其他地區，對明確資訊的需求日益增長。醫療提供者正為更多病患做好準備，許多人擔心死亡人數將持續攀升。高德曼醫師警告，除非更多人透過接種疫苗或從感染中康復而獲得免疫力，否則情況不太可能好轉。他說：「這並非高深莫測的科學，如果我們看到更多麻疹病例，就會看到更多死亡案例。」

paragraphs.en: For now, the public is left with an incomplete picture of the outbreak. As Congress continues to demand answers, the CDC has yet to explain why the Pennsylvania records were removed or when a new definition for measles deaths will be finished. Until then, the asterisk on the CDC website remains a symbol of a growing disagreement over how the United States tracks and reports this dangerous, preventable disease.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，大眾對於疫情的了解仍不完整。隨著國會持續要求給予答覆，疾病管制與預防中心尚未解釋為何移除賓夕法尼亞州的紀錄，也未說明何時會完成麻疹死亡的新定義。在此之前，疾病管制與預防中心網站上的星號，仍象徵著美國在追蹤與通報這種危險且可預防疾病的方式上，正產生日益嚴重的分歧。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To direct attention toward a specific piece of information or a detail.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 指向、指出（某個資訊或細節）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於指引方向，這裡指符號引導讀者去看註解。文中：This mark points to a note explaining that the agency is working with the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists (CSTE) to create a new, standardized definition for what counts as a "measles death."

keyTerms.definitionEn: In the actual location where an event or situation is happening, rather than from a distance.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 在現場、在實際發生狀況的地方。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上是「在地上」，這裡指實際發生疫情的現場。文中：Meanwhile, the situation on the ground in Pennsylvania is becoming more serious.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Something that is very difficult to understand or do.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 高深莫測的事、極難理解的事。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常用於否定句，表示某事其實很簡單，不需要高深學問。文中："It’s not rocket science," he said.

quiz.question: What is the current status of the four measles deaths from Pennsylvania on the CDC's national dashboard?

options.A: They are confirmed as the primary cause of the current outbreak.
options.B: They have been removed and replaced with an asterisk.
options.C: They are being investigated by the National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System.
options.D: They have been officially reclassified as non-measles related deaths.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，CDC 在收到 HHS 的請求後，將賓州死亡案例從官網移除，並以星號（asterisk）取代。選項 A 錯誤，因為這些數字目前被移除而非確認；選項 C 錯誤，文中提到 CDC 正改用 NCHS 系統而非該系統；選項 D 錯誤，目前僅是定義不明，尚未重新分類為非麻疹死亡。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the CDC's decision to change the reporting definition of a 'measles death'?

options.A: It is a routine update that was planned years in advance.
options.B: It is strongly supported by all medical experts in Pennsylvania.
options.C: It may be a strategic move to potentially lower the official death statistics.
options.D: It is intended to help hospitals in Texas and Utah track the disease more accurately.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第三段，CDC 內部匿名人士暗示，更改定義可能是為了讓死亡人數統計更嚴格，進而降低官方死亡數據。選項 A 錯誤，文中提到這並非針對疫情的直接回應，但時機引發質疑；選項 B 錯誤，文中並未提到所有專家都支持；選項 D 錯誤，文中並未提到此舉是為了幫助其他州追蹤疾病。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'isolate' mean in the context of managing a disease outbreak?

options.A: To separate infected individuals from healthy people to stop transmission.
options.B: To keep detailed medical records of patients in a private database.
options.C: To test individuals for the virus in a laboratory setting.
options.D: To prevent doctors from sharing information with the public.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中提到當檢測率低時，官員難以追蹤病毒傳播或要求病患「isolate」，後文解釋為「staying away from others to prevent the spread of a disease」（遠離他人以防止疾病傳播）。這與隔離的概念一致。選項 B、C、D 皆與文中對「isolate」的定義及上下文語境不符。

quiz.question: What is the central message of this article regarding the CDC's handling of the measles outbreak?

options.A: The CDC has successfully contained the measles outbreak in Pennsylvania.
options.B: The current measles outbreak is caused by a new, vaccine-resistant virus strain.
options.C: Public health experts agree that the CDC's new definition of measles is the most accurate.
options.D: Controversy and confusion surround the CDC's reporting methods and the transparency of its data.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。全文重點在於 CDC 更改死亡定義引發的爭議、數據不透明、與各界對其報告方式的質疑。選項 A 與文意相反，疫情仍在擴散；選項 B 誇大了文中對新形式麻疹的描述，並非文章主旨；選項 C 錯誤，文中明確提到專家對此舉感到擔憂與困惑，並非達成共識。
